title: Not yet

nodes.speaker: Kenzy Voan
nodes.text: Keep working to get those flyers out there. The more we spread the word, the more reviled we'll be when we ascend to the most epic of clubs.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Keep working to get those flyers out there. The more we spread the word, the more reviled we'll be when we ascend to the most epic of clubs.

nodes.speaker: Kenzy Voan
nodes.text: Shit, what didn't happen. We sprang on the scene like a group of viral AIs. There was nothing we couldn't do, no place we couldn't get into.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Shit, what didn't happen. We sprang on the scene like a group of viral AIs. There was nothing we couldn't do, no place we couldn't get into.

nodes.speaker: Kenzy Voan
nodes.text: You wouldn't believe me if I told you.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You wouldn't believe me if I told you.

nodes.speaker: Kenzy Voan
nodes.text: Next time.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Next time.

nodes.speaker: Kenzy Voan
nodes.text: Haha. Still not done with those flyers, huh?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Haha. Still not done with those flyers, huh?

nodes.speaker: Kenzy Voan
nodes.text: You really wanna know what happened to all of us, don't you?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You really wanna know what happened to all of us, don't you?

nodes.speaker: Kenzy Voan
nodes.text: That's what it was all about, peace for just a few minutes.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: That's what it was all about, peace for just a few minutes.

nodes.speaker: Kenzy Voan
nodes.text: At the end of the day we're all just flawed sacks of cells.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: At the end of the day we're all just flawed sacks of cells.

nodes.speaker: Kenzy Voan
nodes.text: We were the same flawed fucks as you are right now. Relationships are hard when you don't communicate.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: We were the same flawed fucks as you are right now. Relationships are hard when you don't communicate.

nodes.speaker: Kenzy Voan
nodes.text: Means we might have taken each other for granted. You know, flawed individuals and all.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Means we might have taken each other for granted. You know, flawed individuals and all.

nodes.speaker: Kenzy Voan
nodes.text: You're almost there! I know you can taste the Spire's clean air. Maybe feel me dancing next to you at the Starlight Lounge? Just gotta put in the admin work and we'll get there. See you soon!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You're almost there! I know you can taste the Spire's clean air. Maybe feel me dancing next to you at the Starlight Lounge? Just gotta put in the admin work and we'll get there. See you soon!

nodes.speaker: Kenzy Voan
nodes.text: Well, in all honesty it isn't that spectacular. In fact, I think I'm gonna end up disappointing you.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Well, in all honesty it isn't that spectacular. In fact, I think I'm gonna end up disappointing you.

nodes.speaker: Kenzy Voan
nodes.text: There's no big story behind the Club Rat Kids. We were four friends who just liked to dance to whatever we called a good song at the time.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: There's no big story behind the Club Rat Kids. We were four friends who just liked to dance to whatever we called a good song at the time.

nodes.speaker: Kenzy Voan
nodes.text: We have to find what makes us pulse, what gives us life. Whatever that is, there's no shame in it. As for the CRKs?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: We have to find what makes us pulse, what gives us life. Whatever that is, there's no shame in it. As for the CRKs?

nodes.speaker: Kenzy Voan
nodes.text: We lived, toured, recorded, sang, rocked, we did fucking everything together. Didn't mean we got along easier than anyone else.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: We lived, toured, recorded, sang, rocked, we did fucking everything together. Didn't mean we got along easier than anyone else.

nodes.speaker: Kenzy Voan
nodes.text: That's enough of that though. Get out there and finish hanging those holo flyers.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: That's enough of that though. Get out there and finish hanging those holo flyers.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: You got it.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You got it.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: What happened with the Club Rat Kids?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What happened with the Club Rat Kids?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: What happened with the Club Rat Kids?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: What happened with the Club Rat Kids?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: And?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: And?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Say it.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Say it.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Talking to you is more important.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Talking to you is more important.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Talking to you is more important.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Talking to you is more important.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Finish your story about the Club Rat Kids.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Finish your story about the Club Rat Kids.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Finish your story about the Club Rat Kids.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Finish your story about the Club Rat Kids.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: What do you mean?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What do you mean?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: So what happened?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: So what happened?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: There's got to be more to the story than that.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: There's got to be more to the story than that.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: There's got to be more to the story than that.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: There's got to be more to the story than that.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Yeah?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Yeah?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: What's that mean?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What's that mean?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: That embarrassing?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: That embarrassing?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Do I mumble?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Do I mumble?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: In case that was unclear, yes!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: In case that was unclear, yes!
pronounText.TextSheVersion: In case that was unclear, yes!
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: In case that was unclear, yes!

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Then dissappoint me!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Then dissappoint me!

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Take your time!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Take your time!

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Means you just broke up?
